Name: Help Wanted Friendship
Author: LucasK2708
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Help Wanted Friendship[/b][/size][/center]
[center][i]Make your daily quests more rewarding![/i][/center]
[line]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Tired of completing "Help Wanted" quests and only getting gold? This mod gives you [b]Friendship XP[/b] with the quest giver based on the gold reward and your current friendship level. The less they know you, the more impactful your help is!

[line]
[size=4][b]How the XP is Calculated (The Rules)[/b][/size]
The mod dynamically calculates the friendship points you receive using a balanced formula:

[list]
[*][b]Base XP:[/b] 10% of the quest's Gold reward.
[*][b]Heart Multiplier:[/b] For early friendships (0 to 1 heart), you get a 100% bonus on top of your Base XP. For every extra heart after the first, this bonus is reduced by 15% (diminishing returns).
[*][b]Hard Limits:[/b] To keep things balanced, you will [u]always[/u] get at least [b]30 XP[/b], and it caps at a maximum of [b]100 XP[/b] per quest.
[/list]

[size=4][b]Examples in Action[/b][/size]
[b]Example 1: Early Friendship[/b]
You complete a quest for 320 Gold for a villager you have 1 heart with.
[list]
[*]Base XP: 32 (10% of 320)
[*]Multiplier: 100% bonus (1 heart)
[*]Calculation: 32 + (32 * 1.0) = [b]64 XP[/b]
[/list]

[b]Example 2: Established Friendship[/b]
You complete a quest for 210 Gold for a villager you have 3 hearts with.
[list]
[*]Base XP: 21 (10% of 210)
[*]Multiplier: 70% bonus (100% - 30% reduction for the 2 extra hearts)
[*]Calculation: 21 + (21 * 0.70) = [b]36 XP[/b]
[/list]

[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+).
[*]Download this mod and extract the .zip file.
[*]Place the extracted folder inside your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI!
[/list]
